- Numerous practice-bot AI fixes across many mood cards (Intimidation, Paranoia, Pacifism, Disillusionment, Creativity, Harmony, Cynicism, Zeal, Avoidance, Rationalization, Insecurity) -- bots now make legal, purposeful choices instead of frequently wasting or misplaying these cards
- Open Team Play draft bots now wait for a human teammate before submitting a deck, correctly respect the shared team card pool, and no longer get stuck after a human rejects a turn-order proposal
- Practice bots extended to every draft format (issue #359), plus fixes for Winston Draft turn-forfeiting and "who goes first" deadlocks in bot draft matches
- New: Rotisserie Draft and Tiered Rotisserie Draft formats (issue #361), including card statistics tracking and several display/sorting fixes
- Scoring-correctness fixes for Awe, Sneakiness, Insecurity, Validation/Scorn, and mood-suppression stacking that could otherwise produce an incorrect round outcome
- Reliability: a global exception handler for uncaught errors, and a fix for the game screen permanently failing to load after a transient error
- Users can now request a new verification email if theirs expired or never arrived
- Various UI polish: the New Game dialog, initial card-pass layout, Doubt's board-effect display, and Rotisserie Draft's pool display
- Fixed the root cause of "Could not load this game", and a resigned player's game now correctly moves to their Past games list
- Draft-format games now randomize seating instead of always seating the creator first
